## DEEP TECH THE NEW WAVE

Sponsored by:

“Deep tech isn’t something that’s out of reach and it’s critical to understand its influence on the development of solutions that can improve the lives of millions in vulnerable situations." Irene Arias Hofman, CEO at IDB Lab

“Deep Tech provides opportunities to make the 
world a better place while achieving attractive 
returns for investors.” 
Enrique Duhau, LP & Co-Founder at AIR Capital 
& Chairman at Administración Enrique Duhau 

“We invested in dozens of Deep Tech startups and we are only getting started, there is huge growth potential.” Matias Peire, Founder at GridX “We see world class opportunities in areas that go beyond science such as space, AI and blockchain.” Diego González Bravo, MP at Draper Cygnus

“LAC startups are achieveing things that people still think are impossible.” Nicolas Tognalli, MP at CITES “LAC has great scientists and we are working to translate that into world class innovation.” Markus Schreyer, MP at The Ganesha Lab

“Deep Tech startups can generate new industries and play a critical role in the development of the region.” Carlos Batthyány, MP at Lab+ & Executive Director of Institut Pasteur de Montevideo

“We think LAC startups have structural advantages to compete in Deep Tech globaly.” Sebastián Alejandro Tapia, Partner at Deloitte

This report offers an intellectual foundation to understand the evolution of the LAC Deep Tech 
innovation ecosystem. The report is for information purposes only and should not be relied upon as 
a basis for investment decisions. Investing in technology startups involves risk and requires 
expertise, as well as a deep analysis of specific opportunities. All statements made regarding 
companies are strictly beliefs and points of view held by the authors and are not endorsements or 
recommendations to buy, sell or hold any security. The authors, sponsors and the IDB Lab may hold 
positions in the companies discussed in the document. 
Keywords: Latin America, Innovation, Technological change, Innovation, Venture Capital, Startup 
ecosystem, Exponential growth, Biotech, Deep Tech.

Acknowledgments

This report is the product of teamwork and collaboration with the IDB Lab, AIR Capital, CITES, Deloitte, Draper Cygnus, The Ganesha Lab, GridX and Lab+. All the analyses contained in this study were developed by a team made up of Micaela Jenik, Federico Sioli, Tobias Polacek, Candelaria Peña, and Guillermina Ogando under the leadership of Ignacio Peña. The report was enriched by valuable inputs from sponsor teams, including Ana Luisa Albarran (IDB Lab), Irene Arias Hofman (IDB Lab), Pedro Blas (IDB Lab), Marcelo Cabrol (IDB Lab), Ana Castillo (IDB Lab), Ruben Doboin (IDB Lab), William Ernest Mondol (IDB Lab), Maria Elena Nawar (IDB Lab), Edgar Adrián Parra Oyervides (IDB Lab), Gonzalo Rivas (IDB), Andrés Rubio (IDB Lab), Carlos Batthyány (Lab+), Alejandro Duhau (AIR Capital), Enrique Duhau (AIR Capital), Paul Elberse (Lab+), Ariel Gigante (Deloitte), Diego Gonzalez Bravo (Cygnus Draper), Matías Peire (GridX), Ignacio Plaza (Cygnus Draper), Daniel Salvucci (Cygnus Draper), Markus Schreyer (The Ganesha Lab), Sebastián Alejandro Tapia (Deloitte), Nicolás Tognalli (CITES) and Arturo Torres (Cygnus Draper).

The quality of the report was also significantly enhanced by the generous contributions and insights from ecosystem players, including Lino Barañao (Former Minister of Science & Technology), Luis Barletta (Feedvax), Lisandro Bril (Oikos), Carmelo Cintron (SOSV), Andrés Cuesta (Trampoline), Lucas Delgado (Emerge), Rodrigo Diez (Novo Space), Dominique Duhau (Nanotica Agro), Varinka Farren (Hub APTA), Rocío Fonseca Chamorro (Emerge Lab), Susana García Robles (Capria), Carolina Gutierrez (Sr. Advisor on Innovation), Juan Francisco Llamazares (Stamm), German Losada (Vemo), Gabriel Mantovani Bottós (Vesper Ventures), Daina Paulikas (Deep Tech advisor), Guy Perelmuter (GRIDS), Ilan Rosenberg (Arcomed Labs), Rogelio de los Santos (Dalus), Daniel Scachi (Aceleradora Litoral), Marina Simian (Oncoliq), Luis Stein (Innovation advisor), Silvia Torres Carbonell (IAE) and Federico Trucco (Bioceres). We want to express our special gratitude to Gabriel Perez from Pitanga, who not only generously spent a few hours sharing his valuable insights about the Brazilian ecosystem but also shared some of his analyses and introduced us to key players in the ecosystem.

We are witnessing a Big Bang of Deep

Tech innovation

Global factors such as climate change, high debt levels, and aging populations elsewhere will impede LAC’s progress within the current technology paradigm. Policymakers face mounting difficulty in achieving a balance between economic growth, social development, and environmental protection. However, Deep Tech innovation presents an opportunity for LAC countries to bypass traditional development obstacles and unlock unprecedented possibilities. Cutting-edge technologies like AI, solar power, electric vehicles, biotech, advanced manufacturing, and space-based broadband have the potential to pave new paths for economic growth, social equity, and environmental sustainability in the region. Solar energy is a prime example. Its broad adoption can decrease electricity costs, stimulate economic growth, and create jobs.
